Title: NATTO-KIN+ENZYME — the Japanese Supplement That Skips the Natto

Description:
NATTO-KIN+ENZYME (by HIRO+TOKYO) is a supplement found at Don Quijote in Osaka — instead of eating natto itself, you take the fermenting bacteria straight, packed into a pill. The label claims 45 billion natto bacteria, 18 billion lactic acid bacteria, and 1.8 billion butyric acid bacteria, plus pineapple, papaya, and kiwi enzymes. It's a spore-forming strain that's said to survive stomach acid and reach your intestines alive — one tablet after each meal, four a day.
